blocks.text: Peruvian President Keiko Fujimori will meet with Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi on Nov. 20 in Japan, the Peruvian government said Monday. Fujimori, who took office in July and became the second person of Japanese descent to serve as the country’s head of state, after her father, is scheduled to attend the two-day Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum leaders’ meeting in Shenzhen, China, through Nov. 19, and arrive in Japan on the same day.
